fold_assignment: Exactly one fold. The left vertical edge of the displayed remaining half-sheet, x=13 in its local display panel, is the fold; the right straight edge is an outside edge. Reflect the whole removed half-opening about x=13.
analytic_cut: The cut joins (13,5.4) and (13,6.6) on the fold. It has circular arc portions of radius .6 centered at (13,6) and one three-point zigzag on the right, with middle tip (14.25,6) and two side tips (13.98,5.55),(13.98,6.45). Its reflected partner supplies the left three-point zigzag. The removed half-opening has a segment of positive length on the crease, so the two removed interiors join across an interval, not a single point.
construction: After reflection there is one connected finite-width rounded central opening with three points on both left and right. Translate center (13,6) to (20,0) to obtain the native D contour. The fold line is an axis of the whole opening, not two local axes of separate holes.

exhaustive_choices.A: Two single-sided openings have disjoint interiors. Their star tips may touch at a point at the fold, but a point does not reproduce the positive-width central opening.
exhaustive_choices.B: Two outward-pointing openings have separate interiors; their circular boundaries can be tangent, still no positive-width joined center.
exhaustive_choices.C: Only one right zigzag and no left reflected zigzag; not invariant under the displayed vertical fold.
exhaustive_choices.D: One central rounded region and two mirrored outer zigzags, exactly the reflected half-cut.
exhaustive_choices.E: Two separate locally double-sided openings, with local centers away from the global fold; a point contact at the seam does not connect their interiors. It duplicates an already completed reflection instead of joining the two halves.

display_note: Curve sample vertices are rendering construction samples, not new physical vertices or extra cuts. No new fold is permitted.

fold_side_exhaustion_before_calls.reason_for_appendix: Make the left-fold interpretation exhaustive under the wording can result, without adding a source condition.
fold_side_exhaustion_before_calls.argument: All five candidate paper frames have the same wide rectangle with a central vertical dotted half-fold; the displayed folded packet is its square half. If the cut left boundary of that packet is the fold, reflection joins the half-opening across a positive-length interval, giving D exactly. If the left cut boundary is instead an outer free edge and the right boundary is the fold, opening gives notches on the two exterior left/right paper boundaries, not any candidate internal opening. A horizontal-edge interpretation likewise leaves this cut connected to the outside boundary and does not yield any of the shown internal cutouts. A/B/E have two opening interiors rather than the one joined opening; C is not a vertical reflection invariant. Thus D alone CAN result. This does not require silently declaring all possible source edges to be the fold or editing the prompt.
fold_side_exhaustion_before_calls.native_gap_qualification: The conceptual B circles are tangent in the schematic picture; the native polygonal arc sampling leaves a positive gap of about .001948 display units between its facing boundaries, smaller than a pixel. Either convention has two disjoint interiors. E/A may have exact point contacts, also without a positive-width opening. The proof uses interiors and fold intersection, not pixel gap measurement.
